title: LaszloSaldo | Family finances — Laszlo – MesterWeb
description: Organise income, expenses, budgets, savings goals and debts with LaszloSaldo, the Windows family finance program by Laszlo – MesterWeb.
headline:
Your money, clear.
Your family, organised.
intro: Income, expenses, goals and debts in one place. Discover LaszloSaldo: a visual way to understand and organise your household finances.
overviewTitle: A complete view of your finances.
overviewText: From everyday purchases to plans for the whole family: see what comes in, what goes out and what remains.
featureIntro: A tool for recording, reviewing and planning, with practical tables and easy-to-read charts.
p1: Record income and expenses by date, category, family member and shop or provider. Customise categories and review your entries.
p2: Set category limits and review warnings when spending exceeds your budget.
p3: Add contributions to an existing goal and follow progress through its history and charts.
p4: See amounts paid and outstanding, identify the payer and link instalments to confirmed transactions.
p5: Track recurring payments and analyse monthly spending for each family member, with category details.
p6: Compare income and expenses, review earlier periods and enlarge charts. Export reports to PDF or CSV.
p7: Store documents with custom names and view upcoming deadlines and weekly events inside the program.
p8: Choose where to save a backup of your data. Work across multiple years and find records using search.
galleryTitle: From the overview to every detail.
galleryIntro: Actual screenshots of the English test version. Click to enlarge; all displayed data is fictional.
sp1: Choose a date, category and family member. Enter the amount and, when needed, the shop or provider.
sp2: Review totals and charts to see how your finances change from month to month.
sp3: Adjust your budget and review your goals, debts and upcoming payments.
privacyText: LaszloSaldo stores data locally. You don’t need to connect your bank or upload transactions to a cloud platform. Keep backups to protect your work.
a1: No. LaszloSaldo is a standalone Windows program. You can view its tables and charts and export PDF reports without Excel.
q2: Can I work with multiple years?
a2: Yes. Select a year and month, review records and compare periods without creating a new file for each year.
a3: The interface is available in Spanish, English and Hungarian. You can switch languages within the program.
q4: Does it automatically import bank transactions?
a4: No. Transactions are recorded in the program. Subscriptions and debt instalments can be linked to existing transactions with confirmation to avoid duplicate expenses.
q5: When can I download it, and how much will it cost?
a5: The Windows installer is in preparation. Pricing and licence terms will be announced when confirmed. You can email us for information.
q6: Do reminders work when the program is closed?
a6: Upcoming events and deadlines are shown inside LaszloSaldo while the program is open.
launchTitle:
One home. Many expenses.
A clearer picture.
launchText: We are preparing the Windows installer. Contact us for information about LaszloSaldo availability and terms.
footerText: Practical programs and websites for small businesses.
